```sql
SELECT 
    CAST(SUM(
        CASE 
            WHEN a.currency = 'AUD' THEN a.spend_local * COALESCE(f.aud_nzd_rate, 1.0)
            ELSE a.spend_local
        END
    ) AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS answer
FROM staging.stg_marketing__ad_spend a
LEFT JOIN staging.stg_erp__fx_rates f 
    ON a.spend_date = f.rate_date
WHERE a.spend_date >= DATE '2026-01-01' 
  AND a.spend_date <= DATE '2026-01-31';
```
